_comment: CAUSE-POSES (1 Nov 2026): roster-wide hurt/faint settle for every rig (F36 recipes and own-clip/remake species), scripts/creatures/creature_pose_settle.gd. Each section is its own flag, OFF until GPU judging. faint.grounded: dense pivot keys plant every faint sample on the standing ground line and re-centre the posed body over its contact shadow. faint.side_lie: a faint that still stands at its end rolls onto its side about the body's forward axis (roll_sign +1 rolls the back toward the body's right). faint.head_lift: the neck lifts a buried or downward head at faint end. faint.face_camera: at play_faint the settled collapse turns (ramped, about its standing centre) so the body lies across the camera's view with its back toward the camera (no end-on blob, belly away). hit.recoil: a hit that barely moves gains a held pivot recoil. hit.grounded: every hit sample is planted (no hop). Composes with f36_pose_candidates.json flags (including roster_pose_r1) and creature_clip_flags.json: it reads whatever clip those leave.

side_lie._exclude_why: Shelled and many-legged bodies collapse flat on their own legs rather than rolling onto an edge (CPU stage: Cragclaw stood on its shell rim).
